guide-entry-759b97df61d7798cc186a748.description: Report of the International Law Commission on the work of its sixty-fifth session, 6 May to 7 June and 8 July to 9 August 2013 The Commission reconstituted the Study Group on The Most-Favoured-Nation clause, under the Chairship of Mr. Donald M. McRae. In his absence, Mr. Mathias Forteau served as Chair. The Study Group held four meetings on 23 May, and on 10, 15 and 30 July 2013. At its 3189th meeting, on 31 July 2013, the Commission took note of the report of the Study Group. Discussion in Plenary : 3189th , 31 July 2013. ILC Report, A/68/10 , 2013, chap. XI, paras. 150–164 See the website of the Sixth Committee of the General Assembly and the topical summary of debate in the Sixth Committee ( A/CN.4/666 )

guide-entry-83ad29ad55fc6e501d41de0f.description: Report of the International Law Commission on the work of its sixty-seventh session 4 May–5 June and 7 July–7 August 2015 The Commission, at its 3249th meeting on 12 May 2015, reconstituted the Study Group on The Most-Favoured-Nation clause, under the Chairship of Mr. Donald M. McRae. The Study Group held two meetings on 12 May and 16 July 2015. The Commission received and considered the final report of the Study Group at its 3264th and 3277th meetings on 6 and 23 July 2015, respectively. At its 3277th meeting, on 23 July 2015, the Commission welcomed with appreciation the final report on the work of the Study Group , and adopted five summary conclusions (para. 42). The Commission commended the final report to the attention of the General Assembly, and encouraged its widest possible dissemination. Discussion in Plenary : 3249th meeting (12 May 2015), and 3264th and 3267th meetings (6 and 23 July 2015). ILC Report, A/70/10 , 2015, chap. IV, paras. 32–44 See the website of the Sixth Committee of the General Assembly and the topical summary of debate in the Sixth Committee ( A/CN.4/689 )

guide-entry-8b3d9d32a87f042dcce83ac3.description: Report of the International Law Commission on the work of its sixtieth session, 5 May to 6 June and 7 July to 8 August 2008 The Working Group on the Long-term Programme of Work recommended the inclusion of the topic in the long-term programme of work on the basis of the report of the 2007 Working Group chaired by Mr. D.M. McRae (A/CN.4/L.719). The inclusion of the topics in the programme of work of the Commission was proposed and the establishment, at the sixty-first session of the Commission, of a study group on the topic was recommended. The Commission endorsed the recommendation for the inclusion of the topic on the long-term programme of work. ILC Report, A/63/10 , 2008, chap. XII(A)(4), paras. 351–352 See the website of the Sixth Committee of the General Assembly and the topical summary of debate in the Sixth Committee ( A/CN.4/606 and Add.1 )
